events.summary: Gideon Jura tells an aggressor they were defeated the moment they declared aggression.
events.quote: You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression.

events.summary: Liliana Vess offers a choice between ruling living or dead realms.
events.quote: For every living person there are generations of dead.

events.summary: Creatures displaced from time still turn up, stranded by the temporal disaster that swept across Dominaria.
events.quote: stranded by the temporal disaster that once swept across Dominaria.

events.summary: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved easy; getting them to lie back down was not.
events.quote: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved far easier than getting them to lie back down.

events.summary: Elesh Norn speaks of blessing a world.
events.quote: It is as if this world has been expecting our blessings.
